author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube
text:
Imagineering Storytellers | New Magic for Pirates, Tropical Americas & Piston Peak
Story is at the heart of everything we do at Imagineering. What do we want guests to feel? Where do we want to take them? And how do we bring that story to life?

In this episode of We Call It Imagineering, go behind the scenes with the Imagineers who shape the stories behind our parks and experiences. See how they’re bringing new magic to Pirates of the Caribbean at Walt Disney World during an upcoming period of routine maintenance and creating new ways to explore the worlds of beloved characters.

🎥 *About the Series*
Come along as we take you on an inside look at Walt Disney Imagineering. Inspired by how Walt took us along during the development of Disneyland, this new series brings you into the creative and design journey as Disney Imagineers create new, innovative experiences for guests to enjoy at Disney Parks around the world!
